selection: Fewest named improvements, then smallest maximum logarithmic usage. Gamma/Q slack is removed at the selected geometry.
interpretation: Minimum-usage points carry zero payload. Full endpoint points reoptimize geometry for maximum payload at scored SF >= 1. Negative payload denotes a mass deficit.
